discourse.utterance: A single user or system message, chunked semantically.
discourse.subtopic: A narrower subject nested under a topic.
discourse.digression: A departure from the active topic that may contain latent requirements.
discourse.callback: A reference to a previously discussed topic or idea.
discourse.return_marker: A cue indicating the user wants to resume a prior thread.
discourse.story: A narrative segment containing implicit requirements.
discourse.insight: A user realization that may modify or create requirements.

threading.design_thread: A coherent sequence of utterances related to a subsystem or feature.
threading.deactivation: When a thread is paused or dropped.
threading.cross_link: A semantic relationship between two threads.
threading.confidence: Model confidence in the thread’s inferred meaning.

requirements_ir.component: A system part with behavior, state, and interfaces.
requirements_ir.interface: A boundary through which components interact.
requirements_ir.operation: A function or action performed by a component.
requirements_ir.state: A condition or configuration of a component.
requirements_ir.transition: A change from one state to another.
requirements_ir.invariant: A condition that must always hold true.

ui_annotations.highlight_type: visual cue applied to a snippet (bold, underline, color, glow).
ui_annotations.highlight_reason: why the system highlighted this snippet (insight, requirement, risk).
ui_annotations.ui_marker_id: unique ID for the UI element marking the snippet.
ui_annotations.user_acknowledged: whether the user confirmed or expanded the captured snippet.
ui_annotations.auto_capture: whether the system captured the snippet automatically.
ui_annotations.capture_scope: the range of utterances included in the note.

metadata.source_utterances: IDs of utterances supporting this IR element.
metadata.traceability: Links between IR elements and their origins.
